about: UI overhaul work packages. Order and packages: Mockups/fleet/BUILD-PLAN.md (kit first, 2026-10-10); rules, checks and specs: Mockups/IMPLEMENTATION.md. Fixed data: edit by hand only to re-plan. Live status is in ui-overhaul-status.csv, written only by Mockups/overhaul/ui_overhaul.py.

tiers._note: Owner decision 2026-10-10: one preferred model per WP; the second entry is used only when the first one's runner is at its usage limit, signed out or missing (Claude <-> Gemini). Mechanical WPs prefer Gemini 3.8 Flash; everything else prefers its Claude model. Opus WPs never fall back to Gemini; they wait for Claude (owner 2026-10-10).

antigravity._note: agy 1.2.16; the prompt is the value of -p, so it goes last. Unrestricted (--dangerously-skip-permissions) as in the SDIS plan (owner decision 2026-10-04: restricted print mode refuses every command, so a worker cannot run tests). Gemini follows GEMINI.md's allow/block lists and the runner prompt; the repository's pre-push hook refuses any push (SGT_OVERHAUL_WORKER).

wps.what: Baseline: full test suite, start-up and memory numbers, current snapshots
wps.focus: Change no code. Run the full test suite and record pass/fail counts and the NAMES of failures in your hand-off note (locally: the live T/F/S plugin from CLAUDE.md; in a cloud Linux session: QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen python -m pytest -q tests with a per-test timeout, and say which test modules could not even be collected and why - Windows-only imports are expected). Run tests/test_startup_speed.py and tests/test_memory_tuning.py and record their numbers or why they could not run. Run tools/ui_snapshots.py Mockups/baseline (renders every screen offscreen on fake data; never touches master.db; use the Python your prompt names) and note how many PNGs it wrote and any screen it failed on. Confirm you are on branch ui-overhaul. In your hand-off note state clearly whether this environment can run the offscreen UI tests, so the owner knows if cloud sessions are viable for later packages.

wps.what: Behaviour lock: tests for every 'must still work' item, green on the unchanged code
wps.focus: Read Mockups/IMPLEMENTATION.md sections 1 (rules), 2 and 5 (all of R1-R9); and the mockup spec(s) named below. For each R item with no test today, write an offscreen Qt test (QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen, throwaway DB as in tools/ui_snapshots.py, fictional clients) in tests/test_ui_lock_*.py: search keys and Enter, Alt+n and Alt+Ctrl+n per service, masking First N / Last N, clipboard wipe rule, settings save keys (golden dict of every setting written for a fixed sequence of inputs), visibility save, audit filters and CSV export (store a golden export file in tests/data/), sync dialog columns and attributes, Manage Clients (R7), Tracker Dump (R8: reuse tests/test_tracker_dump_*.py and test_responsive.py, add only what they miss) and display scale (R9: reuse tests/test_ui_scale.py). They MUST pass on the unchanged code; if the old code shows a bug, record it as a decision and test the current behaviour. Do not change app code. Record R items that cannot be tested without a real desktop as checks (check-add).

wps.what: Screen inventory
wps.focus: Write Mockups/INVENTORY.md: for every PNG in Mockups/current/ give the file and class, how it is opened, the tests that cover it, and a table of its controls (attribute name, type, what it triggers). Add the display scale dialog and the sidebar Display entry (ui/dialogs/display_scale_dialog.py; no PNG). List dlg_sgt_lab.png and the SDIS dialogs as 'out of the overhaul' with no control table. Mark every attribute name that a test under tests/ reaches (grep tests for it). This is the basis for the screen packages and for the 'where every control goes' checks. Change no code.

wps.what: Fleet redesign mockup (cloud, Fable 5.1): every screen in one new HTML mockup
wps.focus: Cloud only: the owner starts it with Fable 5.1 using `prompt W0-D`; the local dispatcher never runs it. Redesign every screen in Mockups/current/ (except dlg_sgt_lab.png: the SGT lab and the SDIS panels are out of the overhaul) as one new clickable HTML mockup in Mockups/fleet/ (index.html + README.md). Design only: no app code, nothing outside Mockups/fleet/ except the tracker files. Full instructions are in Mockups/overhaul/fleet-redesign-cloud.md. Done 2026-10-10: the result is Mockups/fleet/ (index.html, README.md, BUILD-PLAN.md).

wps.what: Review the safety net
wps.focus: For each area of W0-2 (search, detail, settings, audit, sync) mutate ONE behaviour in the app code (e.g. change the Alt key map, drop a setting key from the save, remove Enter handling), confirm a lock test goes red, then undo with git checkout of that file only. List areas whose tests did not catch the mutation and fix the tests. Confirm INVENTORY.md covers every PNG in Mockups/current/.
